🖤 Godfather Mafia – Dark, fruity plum opening with a bold, masculine bad-boy vibe.

The biggest surprise? The 20-day macerated oil gives a much smoother first spray without that harsh alcohol blast, and the pressurized atomizer feels premium too.

If you had to pick just one based on the description…👇
